:::{#def-validation-set}
#### Validation set

A **validation set** is a [held-out set](#def-held-out-set)
$\paren{(x^{\text{val}}_1, y^{\text{val}}_1), \ldots, (x^{\text{val}}_m, y^{\text{val}}_m)}$
used to choose among candidate [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure)
$g_1, \ldots, g_L$,
such as one procedure at several values of a [tuning parameter](#def-tuning-parameter),
by the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of each procedure's rule on it:

$$
\est{l} \eqdef \argmin_{l} \frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m
\sqf{g_l\paren{x^{\text{val}}_j; \trainset} - y^{\text{val}}_j}.
$$ {#eq-validation-set}

:::
